instruction.text: Drag the adverbial phrases to the correct categories.
Which type of adverbial is used to link the paragraphs?

atoms.a:
Last week, I went to the fair with my mum. We went on lots of different rides and ate lots of popcorn and candy-floss.

Next week, I am going to the beach with my grandmother. We are going to build sand castles.

feedback.end: A new paragraph is often used when there is a change of tense. In this example, the tenses change from past tense to future tense.

atoms.a:
In the shop, my brother bought the ingredients to make some pasta. He forgot to get the tinned tomatoes.

At home, my brother looked in the cupboards for tinned tomatoes, but he couldn’t find any.

feedback.end: A new paragraph is often used when there is a change of location. The adverbials of place, “in the shop” and “at home” show this change.

atoms.a:
My dad is planning a surprise party for my mum. Firstly, he has to buy a cake. My mum only likes chocolate cake, so he will have to find one that has chocolate in it.

Secondly, he has to send all the invites to the guests. My mum has lots of friends, so there are lots of invites to send.

feedback.end: The adverbials of number, “firstly” and “secondly” link the paragraphs by ordering the two events.

instruction.text: Select the correct adverbial to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
Last Monday, I went to the dentist. The dentist told me that I needed to return for treatment because I had a broken tooth.

((++Tomorrow Last_Tuesday)), I am going back to the dentist to see what treatment I need.

At school, I am learning about the Tudor period. I enjoy learning about history.

((++At_the_library At_the_zoo)), I use a laptop to do some extra research on Henry VIII.

At 6pm, I have my piano lesson, but I also need to go to the shops for my mum. She needs some flour to bake a birthday cake for my sister.

((++At_4pm Yesterday)), I will have to start getting ready to leave. My piano teacher won’t be very happy if I’m late!
